participants: First 12 lexicographically ordered released participant folders; no score-based subject selection
task: Participant-rated valence: low <=4, high >=6; intermediate ratings excluded
window: Centered exactly 60s inside stimulus; no padding or cross-trial extension
timing: EEGLAB event latencies are 1-based samples, checked against source ISO event time differences and header sampling rate
evaluation: 4x4 crossed participant/stimulus held-out folds; training excludes every held-out participant AND every held-out video ID
models: Fixed fold-fitted StandardScaler + balanced LogisticRegression C=1; EEG, cardiac, fusion and training-majority baseline
licence: dataset_description says CC0; README/LICENSE says ODbL/DbCL. Preserve both and use more protective attribution/share-alike conditions for derived data
access: Public official repository/bucket, no credentials or signed EULA
partial_signal_integrity: Exact HTTP byte range and local SHA256; no full-FDT MD5 verification claim
limitations: Physiological and annotation artifacts remain possible
60s RR features are not five-minute clinical HRV
No facial FER labels, disgust target or raga-response outcomes
